role: Route architecture specialists or run a bounded, read-only deepening scan.
notes: Clear specialist requests dispatch directly. Scans create no worktree; selected implementation returns to Ship.

children.note: Atomic failure behavior and recovery; standalone or return to the calling design, implementation, or review workflow; F-EH1 distinguishes diagnosis
One internal module's interface, seam, and depth; also a conditional Ship caller
Architecture domain entry for bounded consequential system decisions; analysis returns a decision packet, while catalog depth remains under the Review sub-hub
Clean Code/Architecture principles Q&A; F-C1 vs coding-standards
Always-on lean style and Go-specific practice; also soft under Ship; F-C1

Repository concept wiki versus code-synced documentation governance; F-D1 distinguishes them. Both pin exact worktree and authority; living-doc updates may return to a Ship caller, while assessments remain read-only
Explicit, already-installed local codebase-graph extract/query workflow; pins corpus, worktree, output ownership and freshness; never installs, hooks, strict mode, shared output, or backends itself
Consumer-visible contracts and evidence-gated retirement lifecycles; both conditionally return to Ship
One scoped operation; preserve caller, candidate, mode and authority, then return without automatic follow-ons.
Model states, actions, guards and invariants clearly. Preserve caller, candidate, mode and authority; return without automatic follow-ons.

pipeline: pin caller, mode, repository/worktree identity, scope and evidence boundary
clear specialist request → selected child → return to caller
broad improvement request → bounded local read-only scan → Markdown or explicitly requested static HTML report
F9 selected candidate → 1-grill-with-docs or Agent judgment
requested implementation → 0-implement owns workspace, edits, verification and review

forks.question: Define failure behavior or diagnose an unexplained bug?
forks.recommended: Failure behavior for error-handling or recovery requests

forks.question: Design an API contract, a module, or the whole system?
forks.recommended: API contract for endpoint or schema requests

forks.question: Take a deepening idea to Design?
forks.recommended: stay at the report unless the user selects a candidate

forks.question: Enforce standards on code now, or discuss clean-code principles?
Concept wiki (docs/wiki) or living docs + code triggers?
forks.recommended: wiki if raw→concepts; living if drift/triggers
